metadata.title: Sakinah — When should you visit the Haram?
metadata.description: Sakinah reads a photo or clip of Masjid al-Haram, estimates how crowded it is now, and suggests the best time for your visit.

home.title: Should I go now, or wait?
home.lead: Sakinah reads a view of the place, estimates how crowded it is right now, and shows you how far to trust the result.

how.title: How Sakinah works

source.title: Source
source.body: A photo, a clip or a live stream of the place.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.body: We estimate how crowded the scene is from the image itself, without identifying anyone.

result.title: Result
result.body: The density level, with the image quality and how far the estimate can be trusted.

how.note: The analysis tool is still being built; these are the steps it will follow.

analyze.title: Density analysis
analyze.body: The analysis tool is still being built. When it’s ready, you’ll upload a photo or clip here, or pick a live stream, and Sakinah will show you the density level and how far to trust it.

footer.privacy: We don’t keep your photos or videos. Only the analysis numbers are stored, to improve recommendations.
